css:
<style>
    @page {
        size: A4;
        margin: 10mm 12mm 10mm 12mm;
    }

    * {
        font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        color: #000;
    }

    body {
        margin: 0;
        font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
        font-size: 12px;
    }

    .page {
        width: 100%;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
    }

    .org-name {
        font-size: 20px !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
    }

    .org-full-name {
        font-size: 14px !important;
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    .voucher-title {
        font-size: 13px !important;
        font-style: italic;
        margin-top: 3px;
    }

    /* Payee Section */
    .payee-section {
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        margin-top:-20px;
    }

    .payee-table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    

    .payee-table .label {
        font-weight: bold;
        text-align:left;
    }

    .payee-table .value {
        width: 28%;
    }

    /* Account Table */
    .account-table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .account-table th,
    .account-table td {
        border: 1px solid #000;
        padding: 4px 6px;
        text-align: left;
        vertical-align: middle;
    }

    .account-table th {
        font-weight: bold;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .col-account {
        width: 18%;
    }

    .col-description {
        width: 47%;
    }

    .col-debit {
        width: 17.5%;
        text-align: right;
    }

    .col-credit {
        width: 17.5%;
        text-align: right;
    }

    .amount {
        text-align: right;
    }

    .total-row td {
        font-weight: bold;
        border-top: px solid #000;
    }

    .total-label {
        text-align: right;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding-right: 15px !important;
    }

    .total-amount {
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Net Payment */
    .net-payment {
        font-weight: bold;
        margin: 10px 0;
        padding: 5px 0;
       
    }

    /* Narration */
    .narration {
        margin: 8px 0 15px 0;
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    /* Footer Sections */
    .footer-table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        margin: 15px 0;
    }

    .footer-table td {
        padding: 5px 10px;
        vertical-align: top;
        width: 50%;
    }

    .footer-section div {
        line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-section div:first-child {
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Received Section */
    .received-section {
        margin-top: 10px;
        padding-top: 10px;
        border-top: 1px solid #000;
    }

    .received-section div {
        display: inline-block;
        margin-right: 30px;
        line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .received-section div:first-child {
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Print-specific */
    @media print {
        .account-table th {
            background-color: #f5f5f5 !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        }
    }
</style>
